channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from morningNewsSection1, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: Attorney says body cam shows federal agent's Memphis shooting was 'unjustified'
item.description: Jonah Neal's family and lawyer recently viewed footage from the day Neal was shot by a federal agent during a mental health crisis.

item.title: Walmart's Flipkart nears top of India's quick-commerce market two years after launch
item.description: Flipkart's quick-commerce service now handles 1.1 to 1.2 million orders daily, nearly three times its November volume.

item.title: Canada announces retaliatory tariffs starting Sept. 8 after U.S. imposes new duties
item.description: The U.S. has placed 50% tariffs on $20 billion of Canadian goods. Prime Minister Mark Carney says Canada will respond with matching tariffs.

item.title: Opinion: Mr. Rogers finds a new neighborhood each time
item.description: MLB catcher Jake Rogers has had a whirlwind few weeks, moving from the Detroit Tigers to the Baltimore Orioles and then to Boston.
